india.one_line: India sees AI platform debate, security breaches, funding influx, and new Google assistant.

themes.title: Sarvam AI hosts Chinese models
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, an inference platform on Indian GPU clusters that serves eight open-weight models via an OpenAI‑compatible API, with six models from Chinese companies. The startup received a ₹98.68 crore government GPU subsidy, prompting renewed debate over sovereign AI priorities.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI launches Token Factory hosting mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, reigniting sovereign AI debate
Sarvam AI hosts six Chinese models in India, reigniting sovereign AI debate

themes.title: AI security incidents rise in India
themes.text: Hackers used AI‑assisted malware to divert over Rs 65 crore in approved loans from 12 NBFCs in Delhi‑NCR over three months. A ServiceNow survey found that 92 percent of Indian organisations experienced AI agent security incidents in the past year, with only 36 percent containing them within 24 hours.

stories.headline: AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr
92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows

themes.title: Indian AI startups attract new funding
themes.text: Soket AI secured $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to expand foundation model research for enterprise use. Bengaluru‑based Humyn Labs raised $47 million to provide first‑person video data for robotics AI, and Singapore‑headquartered Botsync obtained $11 million to grow its autonomous mobile robot and software platform for factories.

stories.headline: Soket AI raises $4 Mn from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies
Humyn Labs raises $47 million to supply robot training data to U.S. AI developers
Botsync raises $11 million to expand industrial automation

themes.title: Google launches Gemini Tasks assistant
themes.text: Google rolled out its agentic AI assistant, Tasks, for free in six markets including India, bundling it with the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to enable calls, appointments, product comparisons and purchases.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini Tasks assistant for free in six markets
